exact_local_lemmas.unit_contact_smoothness: If Gamma.E_i=1, the unique local intersection has I_p(Gamma,E_i)=1. Since E_i is smooth and I_p(Gamma,E_i)>=mult_p(Gamma), mult_p(Gamma)=1; Gamma is smooth there and meets E_i transversely.
exact_local_lemmas.unit_contact_delta: m_i=1 => local strict-transform delta at that intersection is 0
exact_local_lemmas.multibranch_contact_partition: For r_i>=2, the unordered positive contact orders form an integer partition lambda_i of m_i with length >=2.
exact_local_lemmas.converse_firewall: An integer partition is only a numerically admissible local contact envelope; EX1-02 does not assert geometric realization by a V6 carrier.

parameterized_residual_ledger.local_state_at_node_i: choose an integer partition lambda_i of m_i; normalization-fiber cardinality r_i=len(lambda_i); multibranch branch requires len(lambda_i)>=2

missing_intrinsic_data: which normalization points q_ij coincide in Gamma at singular points on E_i
local analytic branch equations or equivalent pairwise intersection/tangency data on S
unibranch singularity data at points of Gamma∩E_i
delta_interface.contraction_only_case: Distinct smooth points of Gamma on the same E_i can be identified only after contraction to x_i; this gives r_i>=2 for N->B while contributing no strict-transform delta at those points.
delta_interface.intrinsic_singularity_case: If two or more normalization branches coincide at one singular point of Gamma on E_i, or a unibranch singularity occurs there, positive delta_E may arise; contact mass alone does not determine it.

local_counterexample.conclusion: fixed contact m=2 permits arbitrarily large local delta in the unrestricted smooth-surface local category
local_counterexample.scope_firewall: This is a local analytic counterexample to any contact-only delta bound; it is not a construction of a global V6 carrier.

branch_status.exact_blocker: V6 class-level exceptional contacts do not determine branch coincidence/tangency or unibranch singularity data on S, so they cannot determine or bound delta_E sufficiently for exclusion.
branch_status.reopen_condition: Obtain actual-member local equations/jet data, a source-locked theorem bounding singularity delta from the V6 linear system, or a global constraint coupling these contact partitions to the remaining delta budget.
